name: NWI-MFW Metalworking Fabrication & Welding
old_description: Quality metalworking, fabrication, and welding services at the most affordable prices.
about:
NWI-MFW Metalworking Fabrication & Welding operates from two locations in Northwest Indiana: a facility at 8318 W Taft Street in Merrillville and another at 2138 W 47th Avenue in Gary. The company provides metalworking, fabrication, and welding services to customers throughout the region.

Its capabilities cover metal fabrication and welding across a range of materials including mild steel, carbon steel, various grades of stainless steel, exotic alloys, cast alloys, and multiple aluminum grades. The company's website lists metalworking, fabrication, and welding as its core services, and the shop emphasizes workmanship and precision for custom projects, though facility size, headcount, and production volumes are not publicly disclosed.

The company serves industrial and commercial clients requiring custom metal fabrication and welding, though specific industry sectors or named customers are not detailed in public sources. Inquiries are handled through a contact form and direct phone line.

NWI-MFW states that it differentiates itself through affordable pricing, a highly skilled team with years of experience, and a commitment to high-quality workmanship on every project. The company invites potential clients to discuss project requirements directly.
